name: react-stages
description: Stages, super flexible wizard and form components for React
author: Fredi Bach

scripts.build:v1: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/dom/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/test-kit/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:v1: npm run check:docs:v1 && npm run check:apps:v1 && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run build:v1 && tsc -p packages/dom/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/test-kit/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/vanilla/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run check:acceptance:v1 && npm run verify:packages:v1 && npm run performance:v1
scripts.release:check:v1: npm run check:v1 && npm run test:v1 && npm --prefix studio run test:v1 && npm --prefix studio run build && npm --prefix docs run build && npm --prefix examples/vanilla run build && npm --prefix examples/react run build && npm --prefix examples/react test
scripts.test:v1: npm run build:v1 && node --test packages/core/test/*.test.mjs packages/dom/test/*.test.mjs packages/react/test/*.test.mjs packages/test-kit/test/*.test.mjs
